lines.text: If you had the *Byakugan,* no wall could hide *anything* from you.
You'd see *almost everything* around you. All at once.
And far. Hinata can see over *ten kilometers* away.
You'd even see the *361* chakra points inside a body.
Each one is smaller than a *needle tip.* Even the Sharingan can't see them.
One tap from Neji, and that chakra *shuts off.*
But there's one *blind spot.* Right behind your neck.
Kidomaru found it, and fired *straight into it.*
